data/2/entries/7/entries/7/entries/22/en.english: Virgil the {@creature minotaur skeleton} stands guard in the center of the room. Virgil attacks any intruders who aren't escorted by Quentin. A character who has Quentin's magic rod (see {@area area A14|0cb|x}) can use it to telepathically command Virgil.
data/2/entries/7/entries/7/entries/22/en.zh_tw: 名叫維吉爾的{@creature minotaur skeleton}守在房間中央。維吉爾會攻擊任何未由昆汀陪同的入侵者。持有昆汀魔杖的角色（見{@area 區域A14|0cb|x}）可以用它透過心靈感應命令維吉爾。
data/2/entries/7/entries/7/entries/22/en.reason: Complete prose omitted by the source translation; retain all conditions and references.

data/2/entries/7/entries/4/entries/1/ent.english: Three-dragon ante is a card game. If you own an actual three-dragon ante deck, you can play the card game for real. Otherwise, adjudicate the outcome of a three-dragon ante game using d12s and the following rules:
data/2/entries/7/entries/4/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 三龍牌是一種紙牌遊戲。如果你有實體三龍牌牌組，可以實際玩這款遊戲。否則，使用 d12 和以下規則裁定三龍牌遊戲的結果：

data/1/entries/3/entries/1.english: {@creature Dr. Cassee Dannell|KftGV}, a brilliant academic, long ago learned to hide her interest in the occult. She instead built a career gaining expertise in the peoples and cultures of the region surrounding Varkenbluff, continuing her occult research in secret. By age twenty-four, Dr. Dannell had earned her doctorate in anthropology from Varkenbluff University, a prestigious institution in her home city. Her ability to connect local archaeological objects with their cultural context was unrivaled, so after her graduation, Dr. Dannell became a Varkenbluff faculty member and field scientist, accompanying the university's archaeology crews on digs in the area.
data/1/entries/3/entries/1.zh_tw: {@creature Dr. Cassee Dannell|KftGV}是一位傑出的學者，早已學會隱藏自己對神祕學的興趣。她以研究瓦肯布盧夫周邊地區的民族與文化建立學術生涯，私下則繼續神祕學研究。二十四歲時，丹內爾博士已取得家鄉名校瓦肯布盧夫大學的人類學博士學位。她將當地考古文物與其文化背景連結起來的能力無人能及，因此畢業後便留校任教，並擔任田野研究員，隨大學考古隊在當地進行發掘。
data/1/entries/3/entries/1.reason: Restore natural academic prose and preserve written twenty-four without introducing a numeric discrepancy.

data/7/entries/8/entries/9/entries/12/en.english: {@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV} (see the {@area end of the adventure|2e9|x}) is here with his students from 9 a.m. to noon. The students often return to this room between the hours of 6 p.m. and 9 p.m. to play music without supervision.
data/7/entries/8/entries/9/entries/12/en.zh_tw: {@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV}（見{@area 冒險末尾|2e9|x}）從上午 9 點到中午會和學生待在這裡。學生常在晚上 6 點至 9 點之間回到這個房間，自行演奏音樂，無人監督。
data/7/entries/8/entries/9/entries/12/en.reason: Noon is noon; preserve source time notation and music meaning.

data/4/entries/8/entries/4/entries/1/ite.english: Interior spaces are magically heated. The temperature in these areas is a constant 68 degrees Fahrenheit (20 degrees Celsius). The exterior of the prison, including the guard towers, is 0 degrees Fahrenheit (−18 degrees Celsius) or colder. Creatures outside the prison are exposed to {@area extreme cold|152|x} (see below).
data/4/entries/8/entries/4/entries/1/ite.zh_tw: 室內空間以魔法供暖，溫度恆定在華氏 68 度（攝氏 20 度）。監獄外部，包括守衛塔在內，溫度為華氏 0 度（攝氏 −18 度）或更低。監獄外的生物會承受{@area 極寒|152|x}的影響（見下文）。
data/4/entries/8/entries/4/entries/1/ite.reason: Preserve the negative temperature and original units.

data/1/entries/6/entries/4/entries/7/ent.english: The curator carries a master key, while each guard carries a key that unlocks all doors to the area in which the guard is stationed. Guards in {@area area V1|035|x} also have a key to the break room ({@area area V7|04d|x}). A character can steal a guard's key in the same way as they can steal a pass card, described in "Bypassing Alarms" above.
data/1/entries/6/entries/4/entries/7/ent.zh_tw: 館長攜帶著一把萬能鑰匙，而每個警衛都攜帶著一把能開啟他們所駐守區域所有門的鑰匙。在{@area 區域V1|035|x}區域的警衛還有一把休息室（{@area 區域V7|04d|x}）的鑰匙。角色可以像在上文"繞過警報"中描述的偷取通行證卡的方式一樣，偷取警衛的鑰匙。
data/1/entries/6/entries/4/entries/7/ent.reason: A master key opens multiple locks; keep distinct from a person or guild office.

data/1/entries/6/entries/5/entries/7/ent.english: Characters who watch Alda closely notice a fancy clutch she holds behind her back. Inside the clutch is a map of the museum guards' after-hours stations, a master key to the museum's locked doors, and a pass card that allows Alda to bypass the museum's alarms (see "{@area Investigating Security Measures|023|x}" earlier in the adventure for details).
data/1/entries/6/entries/5/entries/7/ent.zh_tw: 仔細觀察艾爾達的角色會注意到她背後拿著一個精緻的手拿包。手拿包裡有一張博物館警衛非工作時間的站點地圖、一把能開啟博物館所有鎖著的門的萬能鑰匙，以及一張能讓艾爾達繞過博物館警報的通行卡（詳見冒險早期的"調查安全措施{@area 調查安全措施|023|x}"部分）。
data/1/entries/6/entries/5/entries/7/ent.reason: A master key opens multiple locks; keep distinct from a person or guild office.

data/6/entries/6/entries/7/entries/1/ite.english: "The windows of the guildhouse are boarded up, and its doors are usually locked. At least three guild members have master keys to the doors: Guildmaster Dusk; Elix the Saint, one of Dusk's lieutenants; and Jaymont the Sinner, the guild's resident spy. The master of ravens, Gwish, might have a key as well. If you want to get your hands on a master key, your best bet is to snatch it from Elix the Saint, who frequents a seedy tavern called the Tipsy Tankard."
data/6/entries/6/entries/7/entries/1/ite.zh_tw: "公會館的窗戶被封閉了，門通常也是鎖著的。至少有三名公會成員擁有萬能鑰匙：公會會長黃昏；聖徒埃利克斯，黃昏的副手之一；以及罪人傑蒙特，公會的常駐間諜。養烏鴉的格威許可能也有一把鑰匙。如果你想弄到一把萬能鑰匙，你最好的機會是從經常光顧一個叫微醺酒杯的破舊酒館的聖徒埃利克斯那裡偷取。"
data/6/entries/6/entries/7/entries/1/ite.reason: A master key opens multiple locks; keep distinct from a person or guild office.

data/6/entries/7/entries/2/entries/0.english: Characters can obtain one of the guildhouse's master keys from Elix the Saint (lawful evil, human {@creature bandit captain}), a high-ranking member of the Agile Hand and one of Guildmaster Dusk's more capable lieutenants. After questioning Grinky, the characters should know that Elix the Saint frequents a tavern called the Tipsy Tankard, which is about a 45-minute walk from the guildhouse. He travels there alone because he likes to flirt with a bartender named Karyssa (neutral, human {@creature commoner}).
data/6/entries/7/entries/2/entries/0.zh_tw: 角色們可以從聖徒埃利克斯（守序邪惡，人類{@creature bandit captain||匪幫隊長}），敏捷之手的高階成員之一，也是公會會長黃昏的得力副手那裡獲得公會館的萬能鑰匙之一。審問格林基之後，角色們應該知道聖徒埃利克斯經常光顧一個叫做微醺酒杯的酒館，它距離公會館大約45分鐘的步行路程。他獨自一人去那裡，因為他喜歡和一個名叫卡莉莎（中立，人類{@creature commoner||平民}）的酒保調情。
data/6/entries/7/entries/2/entries/0.reason: A master key opens multiple locks; keep distinct from a person or guild office.

data/6/entries/7/entries/2/entries/1.english: Elix usually leaves the guildhouse at sundown and returns by midnight. Characters can approach him during this interval and take his master key by force or snatch it from him without his knowledge. As an action, a character within reach of Elix can try to snatch the key from his pocket, doing so with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. If the attempt is made in a crowded place where others might notice the theft, increase the DC by 5.
data/6/entries/7/entries/2/entries/1.zh_tw: 艾利克斯通常會在日落時離開公會會所，並在午夜前返回。角色們可以在這段時間內接近他，並透過武力奪取他的萬能鑰匙或在他不知情的情況下從他身上奪走它。作為一個動作，角色可以在能觸及艾利克斯的範圍內嘗試從他的口袋中奪取鑰匙，成功的 {@dc 10} 敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定可以完成此操作。如果嘗試在擁擠的地方進行，其他人可能會注意到這次盜竊，將 DC 增加 5。
data/6/entries/7/entries/2/entries/1.reason: A master key opens multiple locks; keep distinct from a person or guild office.

data/6/entries/8/entries/2/entries/1/ent.english: Doors in the guildhouse complex are locked unless otherwise noted. Some individuals have keys to specific areas, as noted in their descriptions. Others possess a master key that opens all locked doors in the complex.
data/6/entries/8/entries/2/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 公會館建築群內的門都是鎖著的，除非另有說明。一些人擁有特定區域的鑰匙，這在他們的描述中有所註明。其他人則擁有一把萬能鑰匙，可以開啟建築群內所有上鎖的門。
data/6/entries/8/entries/2/entries/1/ent.reason: A master key opens multiple locks; keep distinct from a person or guild office.

data/6/entries/8/entries/5/entries/5/ent.english: Jaymont carries a master key that unlocks all doors in the guildhouse complex.
data/6/entries/8/entries/5/entries/5/ent.zh_tw: 傑蒙特持有一把萬能鑰匙，可以開啟公會館建築群內的所有門。
data/6/entries/8/entries/5/entries/5/ent.reason: A master key opens multiple locks; keep distinct from a person or guild office.

data/7/entries/7/entries/3/entries/0/ent.english: "Sythian wears a master key around his neck that unlocks doors inside the conservatory. Vordell, the housekeeper, has another master key.
data/7/entries/7/entries/3/entries/0/ent.zh_tw: "西提安脖子上掛著一把萬能鑰匙，可以開啟音樂學院內部的門。管家沃德爾還有另一把萬能鑰匙。"
data/7/entries/7/entries/3/entries/0/ent.reason: A master key opens multiple locks; keep distinct from a person or guild office.

data/7/entries/8/entries/4/entries/1/ent.english: The conservatory's chimneys haven't been cleaned in a long time. A Small character can try to squeeze up or down one, doing so with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check. A failed check indicates that the character makes no progress. To enter or exit a chimney from the top, one must first use an action to try to remove the chimney's stone cap, doing so with a successful {@dc 18} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check. A character in gaseous form can navigate a chimney without having to make these checks or remove the chimney cap.
data/7/entries/8/entries/4/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 音樂學院裡的煙囪已經很久沒有清理過了。一個小型生物可以嘗試擠進或擠出煙囪，需要透過一次 {@dc 15} 敏捷（{@skill Acrobatics||體操}）檢定。檢定失敗則意味著毫無進展。要從煙囪頂部進入或離開，必須首先使用一個動作嘗試移除煙囪的石帽，需要透過一次 {@dc 18} 力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定。氣化形態的生物可以無需進行這些檢定或移除煙囪帽就能透過煙囪。
data/7/entries/8/entries/4/entries/1/ent.reason: Conservatory means the music school in this chapter, not a greenhouse.

data/7/entries/8/entries/4/entries/2/ent.english: The conservatory's doors are made of thick, sturdy oak with iron fixtures. Locked doors are noted in their area's heading and require a master key to open. Sythian has one master key; Vordell, the housekeeper, has another. A character can take an action to try to pick a lock using thieves' tools, doing so with a successful {@dc 18} Dexterity check.
data/7/entries/8/entries/4/entries/2/ent.zh_tw: 音樂學院的門是由厚實堅固的橡木製成，配有鐵製配件。上鎖的門會在其區域標題中註明，並需要一把萬能鑰匙才能開啟。斯提安擁有一把萬能鑰匙；管家沃爾德爾擁有另一把。角色可以採取一個動作，使用盜賊工具嘗試撬鎖，成功完成一次 {@dc 18} 的敏捷檢定即可開啟。
data/7/entries/8/entries/4/entries/2/ent.reason: Conservatory means the music school in this chapter, not a greenhouse.

data/7/entries/8/entries/4/entries/6/ent.english: The conservatory's windows are 6 feet tall and 3 feet wide, their lead frames fitted with dozens of small, diamond-shaped panes of frosted glass. Each window has small hinges on one side of it, allowing it to be swung open like a door. All windows are latched shut from the inside except on hot days. As an action, a character can try to force open a latched window, doing so with a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, or use thieves' tools to unlatch a window from the outside, doing so with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check.
data/7/entries/8/entries/4/entries/6/ent.zh_tw: 音樂學院窗戶高達6尺，寬3尺，鉛製框架上鑲嵌著數十塊小的菱形磨砂玻璃。每扇窗戶的一側都裝有小鉸鏈，可以像門一樣向外開啟。除炎熱天氣外，所有窗戶都從內部閂上。作為一個動作，角色可以嘗試強行開啟閂上的窗戶，成功透過{@dc 15}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定即可，或者使用盜賊工具從外部開啟窗戶，成功透過{@dc 15}敏捷檢定即可。
data/7/entries/8/entries/4/entries/6/ent.reason: Conservatory means the music school in this chapter, not a greenhouse.

data/7/entries/8/entries/7/entries/2.english: {@b Vordell} (lawful neutral) is a dour, 50-year-old human housekeeper with a full head of salt-and-pepper hair pulled into a ponytail. He carries a master key that opens all locked doors in the conservatory. If he could find employment elsewhere, Vordell would abandon Sythian in a heartbeat. Vordell doesn't like that Sythian partakes in demon worship but keeps his misgivings to himself. Joster's {@condition invisible} quasits torment Vordell by soiling or breaking things, which Vordell must then tidy up. Vordell doesn't know who or what to blame for these unexplained messes.
data/7/entries/8/entries/7/entries/2.zh_tw: {@b 沃爾德爾}（守序中立）是一個憂鬱的50歲人類管家，他有一頭灰白相間的頭髮，紮成了馬尾。他攜帶著一把能開啟音樂學院所有鎖著的門的萬能鑰匙。如果他能在別處找到工作，沃爾德爾會毫不猶豫地拋棄西提安。沃爾德爾不喜歡西提安參與惡魔崇拜，但他把自己的顧慮藏在心裡。喬斯特的{@condition invisible||隱形}夸塞魔透過弄髒或破壞東西來折磨沃爾德爾，沃爾德爾必須隨後清理這些。沃爾德爾不知道這些無法解釋的混亂應該歸咎於誰或什麼。

data/7/entries/8/entries/9/entries/2/ent.english: During the day, characters are most likely to encounter Vordell, the housekeeper ({@creature commoner}), here, setting the table or returning clean dishes and cutlery to the sideboard. Depending on the time of day, the characters might find {@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV} (see the {@area end of the adventure|2e9|x}), Joster the {@creature incubus} in tiefling form, and students here as well (see the {@area Conservatory Schedule table|2a1|x}).
data/7/entries/8/entries/9/entries/2/ent.zh_tw: 白天，角色們最有可能在這裡遇到管家沃德爾（{@creature commoner||平民}），他在擺桌子或將乾淨的餐具放回餐具櫃。根據時間的不同，角色們可能還會在這裡找到{@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV|西提安·斯考德蘭}（參見{@area 冒險的結束|2e9|x}）、以提夫林形態出現的{@creature incubus||夢魔}喬斯特，以及學生們（參見{@area 音樂學院日程表|2a1|x}）。
data/7/entries/8/entries/9/entries/2/ent.reason: Conservatory means the music school in this chapter, not a greenhouse.

data/7/entries/8/entries/9/entries/8/ent.english: Students sometimes practice music in their rooms from 6 p.m. to 9 p.m. All students can be found in their rooms from midnight until shortly before 8 a.m. (see the {@area Conservatory Schedule table|2a1|x}).
data/7/entries/8/entries/9/entries/8/ent.zh_tw: 學生們有時會在晚上6點到9點在自己的房間裡練習音樂。從午夜到早上8點前不久，所有學生都可以在他們的房間裡找到（見{@area 音樂學院日程表|2a1|x}）。
data/7/entries/8/entries/9/entries/8/ent.reason: Conservatory means the music school in this chapter, not a greenhouse.

data/7/entries/8/entries/10/entries/0.english: If the characters leave the conservatory with Golden Axe and the {@creature chasme} in area C18 is still alive, the demon swoops down and attacks the characters before they get too far. The demon's goal is to return the mandolin to the conservatory. The mandolin is, after all, Sythian's ticket to earning the patronage of Wylie van Timmel's family.
data/7/entries/8/entries/10/entries/0.zh_tw: 如果角色們帶著金斧頭離開音樂學院，並且區域C18的{@creature chasme||喀嘶魔}仍然活著，這個惡魔會俯衝下來，在角色們走遠之前攻擊他們。惡魔的目標是將曼陀林帶回音樂學院。畢竟，曼陀林是西提安贏得懷利·范·提梅爾家族贊助的關鍵。
data/7/entries/8/entries/10/entries/0.reason: Conservatory means the music school in this chapter, not a greenhouse.

data/2/entries/6/entries/3/entries/0.english: Every casino employee carries a pass card made of green metal and embossed with a devil's smiling, winking visage. A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals a faint aura of abjuration magic around the card.
data/2/entries/6/entries/3/entries/0.zh_tw: 每位賭場員工都攜帶著一張綠色金屬製成的通行證卡，上面浮雕著一個魔鬼微笑眨眼的面孔。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術揭示了卡片周圍微弱的防護魔法光環。
data/2/entries/6/entries/3/entries/0.reason: Original describes devils of the Nine Hells, not demons of the Abyss.

data/2/entries/7/entries/3/entries/1/ent.english: The casino has four cashier's stations (in areas {@area A2|0ac|x} and {@area A4|0af|x}), where tiefling cashiers ({@creature Commoner||commoners}) in smiling devil masks make change or trade out cash for chips. The casino's chips are thin, painted wooden disks. Stamped on both sides of every chip is the casino's emblem: a golden pitchfork.
data/2/entries/7/entries/3/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 賭場有四個收銀臺（位於區域{@area A2|0ac|x}和{@area A4|0af|x}），提夫林收銀員（{@creature Commoner||平民}）戴著微笑魔鬼面具在那裡兌換零錢或將現金換成籌碼。賭場的籌碼是薄的、塗漆的木製圓盤。每個籌碼的兩面都印有賭場的標誌：一個金色的乾草叉。
data/2/entries/7/entries/3/entries/1/ent.reason: Original describes devils of the Nine Hells, not demons of the Abyss.

data/2/entries/7/entries/7/entries/6/ent.english: A narrow racing track dominates the center of this section, with shouting and cheering patrons clustered around it. Numbered rats scurry along their respective lanes. As the rats cross the finish line, cries of victory and groans of defeat erupt from the patrons. Just south of the track are a pair of lounge chairs and two cashier booths staffed by tieflings wearing devil masks.
data/2/entries/7/entries/7/entries/6/ent.zh_tw: 一個狹窄的賽跑跑道佔據了這個區域的中心，周圍聚集著歡呼和吶喊的顧客。編號的老鼠沿著它們各自的賽道奔跑。當老鼠穿過終點線時，顧客中爆發出勝利的歡呼和失敗的呻吟。就在跑道的正南方是一對休息椅和兩個由戴著魔鬼面具的提夫林人值守的收銀亭。
data/2/entries/7/entries/7/entries/6/ent.reason: Original describes devils of the Nine Hells, not demons of the Abyss.

data/2/entries/7/entries/7/entries/17/en.english: This roomy office contains an L-shaped desk sized for a gnome, cushioned chairs, and knickknacks on shelves. A painted bas-relief spans the entire north wall and depicts a host of winged devils catching mortals as they plunge into the depths of hell.
data/2/entries/7/entries/7/entries/17/en.zh_tw: 這間寬敞的辦公室設有一個為侏儒量身定做的L形辦公桌、帶墊子的椅子以及架子上的小擺設。一幅彩繪浮雕橫跨整個北牆，描繪了一群帶翼的魔鬼在捕捉那些墜入地獄深處的凡人。
data/2/entries/7/entries/7/entries/17/en.reason: Original describes devils of the Nine Hells, not demons of the Abyss.

data/2/entries/5/entries/2/entries/4/ent.english: "The Afterlife Casino is a new Nine Hells–themed attraction just outside town. The owner, Quentin Togglepocket, built it using prize money he stole from me, and I'd like you to give him hell. He's hosting a tournament there. I want you to steal the erinyes statuette he plans to award as a prize, embarrassing him in front of the big names at the tournament. I also want you to steal back the five thousand gold pieces he stole from me. Bring the statuette and the gold here, where I'll be waiting for you."
data/2/entries/5/entries/2/entries/4/ent.zh_tw: "來世賭場是城外新開的一個以九層地獄為主題的景點。老闆昆汀·圖格拉口袋用從我這裡偷來的獎金建造了它，我希望你們能讓他嚐嚐苦頭。他正在那裡舉辦一個錦標賽。我希望你偷走他計劃作為獎品的罪魔小雕像，在錦標賽的重要人物面前羞辱他。我還要你們幫我偷回他從我這裡偷走的五千金幣。把小雕像和金幣帶到這裡，我會在這裡等你們。"
data/2/entries/5/entries/2/entries/4/ent.reason: Erinyes is a creature name, not a named character.

data/2/entries/7/entries/4/entries/3/ent.english: These machines, referred to by some casino patrons as "tricky devils," are simple clockwork devices that accept copper coins. Each machine has a spring-loaded lever and five identical spinning cylinders called reels. Six golden, Infernal runes are painted on each reel. A player inserts between 1 and 9 copper coins into the machine's slot and pulls the lever, which causes the reels to spin, stop, and display a row of five runes. The player wins by matching three or more runes.
data/2/entries/7/entries/4/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: 這些機器，有些賭場顧客稱之為"狡猾魔鬼"，是簡單的發條裝置，接受銅幣。每臺機器都有一個彈簧拉桿和五個相同的旋轉圓筒，稱為轉輪。每個轉輪上都畫有六個金色的煉獄符文。玩家在機器的投幣口中插入1到9個銅幣，然後拉動操縱桿，這會導致轉輪旋轉、停止，並顯示一行五個符文。玩家透過匹配三個或更多的符文來獲勝。
data/2/entries/7/entries/4/entries/3/ent.reason: Slot-machine reels and spring-loaded lever; retain the coin range and number of reels/runes.

data/2/entries/7/entries/5/entries/0.english: Quentin Togglepocket (lawful evil, gnome {@creature noble}) has a Mephistophelian aspect to his appearance. He dresses garishly, slicks back his wavy hair, curls his mustache, and cultivates a long, pointy beard. Only the freckles across his nose undermine his devilish countenance.
data/2/entries/7/entries/5/entries/0.zh_tw: 昆汀·托格波克（守序邪惡，侏儒{@creature noble}）有著梅菲斯特式的魔鬼外貌。他衣著浮誇，將波浪狀的頭髮向後梳，捲起小鬍子，並蓄著又長又尖的山羊鬍。只有鼻梁上的雀斑稍稍破壞了這副魔鬼般的面容。
data/2/entries/7/entries/5/entries/0.reason: Mephistophelian is a literary description; retain freckles, grooming, and alignment.

data/2/entries/7/entries/5/entries/3.english: Quentin couldn't have accomplished his goals alone. To make his casino a reality, he sold his soul to Mammon, the archdevil of Minauros (the third layer of the Nine Hells). In turn, one of Mammon's subordinates put Quentin in touch with wizards who could help him build and decorate the casino.
data/2/entries/7/entries/5/entries/3.zh_tw: 昆汀不可能獨自實現這些目標。為了建成賭場，他將靈魂賣給統治米瑙洛斯（九層地獄第三層）的魔鬼大公瑪門。作為交換，瑪門的一名部下替昆汀牽線，讓能夠協助建造與裝飾賭場的法師與他合作。
data/2/entries/7/entries/5/entries/3.reason: Mammon is an archdevil; Minauros is a layer of the Nine Hells.

data/2/entries/7/entries/7/entries/11/en.english: Steps lead to the sunken floor of a gambling haven ringed with pillars of black basalt. Seven three-dragon ante tables take up the floorspace. A three-foot-high shelf carved into the far wall bears a glass case, displayed in which is a gold statuette of a winged devil. Standing next to the display case is a tiefling security guard.
data/2/entries/7/entries/7/entries/11/en.zh_tw: 臺階通向一個被黑色玄武岩柱環繞的賭博天堂的下沉地面。七個三龍牌牌桌佔據了地面空間。在遠處牆上雕刻的三尺高的架子上有一個玻璃箱，裡面展示的是一個金色的小雕像，是帶翅膀的魔鬼。站在展示櫃旁邊的是一名提夫林保安。
data/2/entries/7/entries/7/entries/11/en.reason: Three-dragon ante is the casino card game; the displayed statue depicts a devil.

data/2/entries/7/entries/7/entries/17/en.english: A garishly dressed gnome with a devilish countenance to rival Mephistopheles sits behind the desk, stroking his pointy beard. When he notices you, he curls his lips in a lopsided smile. "Well, now," he says. "What can I do for you?"
data/2/entries/7/entries/7/entries/17/en.zh_tw: 一名衣著浮誇的侏儒坐在桌後，撫弄著尖鬍鬚。他那魔鬼般的面容足以與墨菲斯托費利斯媲美。注意到你們時，他歪起嘴角露出笑容。「哎呀，」他說，「有什麼我能效勞的嗎？」
data/2/entries/7/entries/7/entries/17/en.reason: Restore boxed-text dialogue punctuation and the correct devil name.

data/2/entries/7/entries/7/entries/17/en.english: Quentin (lawful evil, gnome {@creature noble}) shrewdly shuns combat, but he draws his rapier and defends himself if threatened and cornered. As an action, he can utter a prayer to Mammon, which causes two {@creature Spined Devil||spined devils} to magically emerge from the bas-relief on the north wall. Each devil appears in an unoccupied space next to the north wall, acts as Quentin's ally, and sticks around for 1 minute before returning to the Minauros, the third layer of the Nine Hells. If the devils are defeated, Quentin shouts for help, attracting the three security guards from {@area area A16|0d5|x} if they haven't already been dealt with.
data/2/entries/7/entries/7/entries/17/en.zh_tw: 昆汀（守序邪惡，侏儒{@creature noble||貴族}）精明地避免戰鬥，但如果受到威脅和被困，他會拔出他的刺劍自衛。作為一個動作，他可以向瑪門祈禱，這將導致兩個{@creature Spined Devil||棘魔}從北牆上的浮雕中魔法般地出現。每個魔鬼出現在北牆旁邊的未佔據空間，作為昆汀的盟友行動，並在返回米瑙洛斯——九層地獄的第三層——之前持續1分鐘。如果這些魔鬼被擊敗，昆汀會呼救，如果還沒有處理，這將吸引來自{@area 區域A16|0d5|x}區域的三名保安人員。
data/2/entries/7/entries/7/entries/17/en.reason: Summoned spined devils return to Minauros; do not confuse it with minotaurs.

data/3/entries/9/entries/3/entries/21/en.english: These rooms were set aside for Markos's pupils, who shared his drive for knowledge but didn't share in their master's reward for contacting Krokulmar. The pupils fled the mansion after Markos made his pact. Each room now contains two {@creature Gray Ooze||psychic gray oozes} (see the "Variant: Psychic Gray Ooze" sidebar in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}) that mill about. They attack intruders on sight.
data/3/entries/9/entries/3/entries/21/en.zh_tw: 這些房間是為馬寇斯的學生們準備的，他們與馬寇斯一樣渴望知識，但沒有分享到他們導師因聯絡克羅克馬爾姆而得到的獎賞。馬寇斯締約後，學生們逃離了這座大廈。現在每個房間都包含了兩隻{@creature Gray Ooze||心靈灰泥怪}（詳見《{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}》中的"變體：靈能灰色軟泥怪"側邊欄）。它們在房間內徘徊，一見到入侵者就會發動攻擊。
data/3/entries/9/entries/3/entries/21/en.reason: The original does not call the Far Realm entity a demon.

data/5/entries/10/entries/6/entries/5/en.english: A thorough search of the building reveals the corpse of a robed deep gnome named Schnella Deepdelve, the master of the town's miners' guild. Schnella refused to leave and died fending off Tockworth's clockwork defenders. Her restless soul lurks in this building, manifesting as a troublesome {@creature specter} known as a {@creature poltergeist} (see the "Variant: Poltergeist" sidebar in the "Specter" entry of the {@book Monster Manual|MM}).
data/5/entries/10/entries/6/entries/5/en.zh_tw: 徹底搜查這座建築會發現一具穿著長袍的地底侏儒屍體，名叫施妮拉·深掘，她是鎮上礦工公會的會長。施妮拉拒絕離開，並在抵禦托克沃斯的發條守衛時死去。她不安的靈魂徘徊在這座建築中，表現為一個麻煩的{@creature specter||惡靈}，被稱為{@creature poltergeist||騷靈}（見《{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}》中"幽靈"條目下的"變體：作祟幽靈"側邊欄）。
data/5/entries/10/entries/6/entries/5/en.reason: Master means the head of this guild, not a skilled craftsperson.

data/6/entries/1.english: A group of scholars and sages known as the Cognoscenti Esoterica recently purchased a painting of Constantori, a famous courtier rumored to once have been the most beautiful man alive. The portrait supposedly has occult properties, but before the sages could study it, the painting was stolen by the Agile Hand, a thieves' guild. In this adventure, the characters must retrieve the portrait of Constantori from the Agile Hand's guildhouse and return it to Adrisa Carimorte, a member of the Cognoscenti Esoterica.
data/6/entries/1.zh_tw: 一群組成「祕學智者會」的學者與賢者，最近購入了一幅康斯坦托里的畫像。這位著名朝臣相傳曾是世上最美麗的男子。據說畫像具有神祕力量，但賢者們尚未展開研究，它就被盜賊公會「敏捷之手」偷走了。在本冒險中，角色必須從敏捷之手的公會館取回康斯坦托里的畫像，交還祕學智者會成員阿德莉莎·卡里莫特。
data/6/entries/1.reason: Cognoscenti Esoterica is the organization name, not an adjective describing scholars.

data/7/entries/7/entries/4/entries/0.english: {@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV} has an {@creature incubus} acquaintance who goes by the name {@creature Joster Mareet|KftGV}. This servant of the demon lord Graz'zt usually takes the form of a tall, beautiful, male tiefling. The incubus has telepathy out to a range of 60 feet, enabling the fiend to have telepathic conversations with Sythian even when they're not in the same room.
data/7/entries/7/entries/4/entries/0.zh_tw: {@creature Sythian Skalderang|KftGV|西提安·斯考德蘭} 有一個名為 {@creature Joster Mareet|KftGV|喬斯特·馬裡特} 的 {@creature incubus||夢魔} 熟人。這個惡魔領主格拉茲特的僕人通常以一個高大、英俊的男性提夫林的形象出現。這個夢魔擁有60尺範圍內的心靈感應能力，使得這個邪魔即使與西提安不在同一個房間時也能進行心靈交流。
data/7/entries/7/entries/4/entries/0.reason: Fiend is the umbrella type; an incubus is not necessarily a demon.

data/7/entries/8/entries/3.english: If the characters tell Sythian that his orchard was poisoned with demon ichor, he concludes {@creature Joster Mareet|KftGV} is responsible but keeps his suspicions to himself. The revelation makes Sythian bitter toward the incubus and poisons their long-term relationship.
data/7/entries/8/entries/3.zh_tw: 如果角色們告訴西提安他的果園是被惡魔之血毒害的，他會得出結論是{@creature Joster Mareet|KftGV|喬斯特·馬裡特}所為，但會將自己的懷疑保留在心中。這一發現使西提安對那個夢魔產生了怨恨，並毒害了他們長期的人際關係。
data/7/entries/8/entries/3.reason: Incubus uses the existing creature-card name 夢魔.

data/7/entries/8/entries/8/entries/3/ent.english: If Sythian becomes suspicious of characters posing as debt collectors, he entertains them long enough for Joster to "fetch the payment." The incubus rounds up the demons in areas {@area C4|2bf|x}, {@area C11|2cb|x}, and {@area C18|2df|x} before returning to dispose of the visitors. When combat erupts, Sythian retreats to his bedroom ({@area area C15|2d6|x}) and grabs {@item Instrument of the Bards, Canaith Mandolin||Golden Axe}. If the characters catch up to him, he tries to escape out the window using the mandolin's {@spell fly} spell.
data/7/entries/8/entries/8/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: 如果西提安對冒充收債人的冒險者產生懷疑，他會以足夠的時間招待他們，以便喬斯特去"取回付款"。這個夢魔會在區域{@area C4|2bf|x}、{@area C11|2cb|x}和{@area C18|2df|x}收集惡魔，然後返回處理訪客。當戰鬥爆發時，西提安退回到他的臥室({@area 區域C15|2d6|x})並抓住{@item Instrument of the Bards, Canaith Mandolin||金斧}。如果冒險者追上他，他會嘗試使用曼陀林的{@spell fly||飛行術}法術從窗戶逃脫。
data/7/entries/8/entries/8/entries/3/ent.reason: Incubus uses the existing creature-card name 夢魔.

data/7/entries/10/entries/4.english: Sythian has attuned to Golden Axe so that he can learn and exercise the {@item Instrument of the Bards, Canaith Mandolin||Canaith mandolin's} properties. Although he hopes Golden Axe will earn him the good graces and financial support of the van Timmels, Sythian would sooner lose the instrument than see any harm befall his students, as his reputation and financial success hinge on their well-being. He gladly gives up the instrument to save himself.
data/7/entries/10/entries/4.zh_tw: 西提安已經與金斧頭調諧，以便他能夠學習和運用{@item Instrument of the Bards, Canaith Mandolin||卡納伊曼陀林的}屬性。儘管他希望金斧頭能為他贏得van Timmel家族的青睞和財務支援，但西提安寧願失去這個樂器，也不願看到他的學生遭受任何傷害，因為他的聲譽和財務成功取決於他們的福祉。為了自保，他願意放棄這個樂器。
data/7/entries/10/entries/4.reason: Attunement is a magic-item rule; remove duplicate possessive.

data/8/entries/7/entries/3/entries/10/en.english: {@i The Diabolical Codex} (covered in spined devil hide), written by a tiefling named Nadir, provides tips and tricks for surviving bargains with devils.
data/8/entries/7/entries/3/entries/10/en.zh_tw: {@i 《魔鬼法典》}（封面是棘魔皮），由一個名叫納迪爾的提夫林所著，提供了與魔鬼交易生存的技巧和竅門。
data/8/entries/7/entries/3/entries/10/en.reason: The codex concerns bargains with devils, specifically has spined devil hide.

data/9/entries/10/entries/3/entries/7/en.english: A recent effort by the Onyx Scar to clear the room for storage led to hostilities with the resident Plant creatures. The myconids and the shambling mound attack anyone who approaches the garden or emerges from the fountain (see "Fountain" below). If one or more myconids are killed, the surviving myconids use their Rapport Spores to signal their surrender. The shambling mound, however, fights until destroyed.
data/9/entries/10/entries/3/entries/7/en.zh_tw: 黑曜之痕最近試圖清空這個房間作為儲藏室，因而與棲居此地的植物生物發生衝突。蕈人與蔓生怪會攻擊任何靠近花園或從噴泉出現的人（見下文「噴泉」）。若有一個或更多蕈人遭殺害，存活的蕈人便使用通念孢子表達投降。但蔓生怪會戰鬥至被摧毀為止。
data/9/entries/10/entries/3/entries/7/en.reason: Restore surrender condition and use the existing Rapport Spores trait name.

data/9/entries/10/entries/3/entries/23/e.english: {@creature Rilago|KftGV}'s offer to mend the giant's heart is genuine. If the characters allow it, {@creature Rilago|KftGV}'s ghost uses Possession against a willing character, who forgoes the saving throw to resist the effect. Only then can the ghost leave the crypt and return the {@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV} to its rightful place. When {@creature Rilago|KftGV}'s host touches the shard to the giant's heart, they bind as one. As the giant's heart is made whole again, {@creature Rilago|KftGV}'s spirit is laid to rest, and the character ceases to be possessed.
data/9/entries/10/entries/3/entries/23/e.zh_tw: {@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}修復巨人心臟的提議是真誠的。如果角色們允許，{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}的鬼魂會使用附身能力對一個願意的角色，該角色自願放棄用於抵抗附身效果的豁免。只有這樣，鬼魂才能離開墓穴，並將{@item shard of Xeluan|KftGV|澤巒碎片}歸還到它合適的地方。當{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}的宿主將碎片碰觸巨人的心臟時，它們合為一體。當巨人的心臟再次完整時，{@creature Rilago|KftGV|里拉戈}的靈魂得以安息，角色也不再被附身。
data/9/entries/10/entries/3/entries/23/e.reason: Forgoing the save permits possession; it does not resist the effect.

data/11/entries/1.english: Wanted for crimes across the multiverse, an outlaw known as {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} is currently a prisoner aboard the Concordant Express, an interplanar train destined for Mechanus, where the outlaw is set to stand trial. In this heist, the characters must obtain a list of names {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} has committed to memory. The names in question are the true names of several powerful demons, devils, and yugoloths.
data/11/entries/1.zh_tw: 一名被稱為{@creature the Stranger|KftGV}的罪犯，因在多元宇宙各處犯案而遭通緝，如今被囚禁在跨位面列車協和快車上。列車正前往機械境，將其送去受審。在這場劫案中，角色必須取得{@creature the Stranger|KftGV}牢記於心的一份名單，其中記載著幾個強大惡魔、魔鬼和尤格羅斯魔的真名。
data/11/entries/1.reason: Remove duplicated place names and distinguish the three fiend groups.

data/11/entries/3/entries/2.english: {@creature The Stranger|KftGV} perpetrated many crimes, none greater than the attempted theft of a book that held the true names of many demons, devils, and yugoloths (see "True Names" below). When {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} tried to flee with the book, a fiendish ward caused the book to disappear. By then, {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} had already committed many of the true names to memory. {@creature The Stranger|KftGV} then set off across the multiverse, making deals with various Fiends in exchange for keeping their true names secret. {@creature The Stranger|KftGV} survived all these dealings unscathed for years, but their luck eventually ran out.
data/11/entries/3/entries/2.zh_tw: {@creature The Stranger|KftGV|陌生人} 犯下了許多罪行，其中最嚴重的是試圖盜竊一本包含許多惡魔、魔鬼和尤格羅斯魔真實姓名的書（見下面的"真實姓名"）。當 {@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人} 試圖帶著書逃跑時，一道邪魔結界導致書消失了。到那時，{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人} 已經記住了許多真實姓名。隨後，{@creature The Stranger|KftGV|陌生人} 踏上了跨越多元宇宙的旅程，與各種邪魔進行交易，以保守他們的真實姓名。{@creature The Stranger|KftGV|陌生人} 多年來在這些交易中毫髮無損地生存下來，但他們的運氣最終耗盡了。
data/11/entries/3/entries/2.reason: Fiends collectively includes demons, devils, and yugoloths.

data/11/entries/3/entries/3.english: Fiendish foes set their sights on {@creature the Stranger|KftGV}, forcing {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} to flee to the Material Plane and take refuge in the city-state of Akharin Sangar, which is ruled by a powerful angelic being. ({@adventure Akharin Sangar|JttRC|11|Akharin Sangar Gazetteer} is detailed further in {@adventure Journeys through the Radiant Citadel|JttRC}). But {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} underestimated the vigilance of Akharin Sangar's celestial host and was caught impersonating an angel. When {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} refused to divulge any information about themself, a deva enforcer named Omid was tasked with delivering {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} to Mechanus to stand trial. The prisoner was clamped in {@item dimensional shackles} and taken aboard the Concordant Express for safe transport.
data/11/entries/3/entries/3.zh_tw: 邪魔仇敵盯上了{@creature the Stranger|KftGV}，迫使{@creature the Stranger|KftGV}逃往物質界，在由一位強大天使統治的城邦阿卡林·桑加爾避難。（{@adventure 耀光城之旅|JttRC}中有{@adventure 阿卡林·桑加爾|JttRC|11|Akharin Sangar Gazetteer}的詳細介紹。）然而，{@creature the Stranger|KftGV}低估了阿卡林·桑加爾天界軍團的警覺，冒充天使時遭到逮捕。由於{@creature the Stranger|KftGV}拒絕透露任何自身資訊，一名叫奧米德的天神使徒執法者受命將{@creature the Stranger|KftGV}押往機械境受審。囚犯被戴上{@item dimensional shackles}，帶上協和快車以確保押送安全。
data/11/entries/3/entries/3.reason: Host means a celestial army; the ruler is an unspecified angelic being while Omid is a deva.

data/11/entries/4/entries/1/entries/0.english: A planar faction known as the Fixers aims to restore balance to the Blood War (the eternal feud between demons and devils) by obtaining the true names of a pit fiend commonly known as Karnyros, a balor called Errtok, and a marilith known as Hexalanthe. A representative of the Fixers hires the characters to obtain these Fiends' true names from {@creature the Stranger|KftGV}.
data/11/entries/4/entries/1/entries/0.zh_tw: 一個名為修理工的位面派系旨在透過獲取一個通常被稱為卡尼羅斯的深獄煉魔、一個名為埃爾托克的巴洛炎魔和一個被稱為赫克莎蘭瑟的六臂蛇魔的真實名字，來恢復血戰（惡魔和魔鬼之間永恆的爭鬥）的平衡。修理工的一位代表僱傭角色們從{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}那裡獲得這些邪魔的真名。
data/11/entries/4/entries/1/entries/0.reason: The requested names include a pit fiend as well as demons.

data/11/entries/7/entries/4/entries/0.english: Embedded in Glitch's body is an {@item amulet of the planes} that turns to dust (along with the rest of the quadrone) if Glitch is reduced to 0 hit points. Glitch uses this built-in amulet to cast {@spell plane shift}, delivering itself and the characters to a field in {@book the Outlands|DMG|2|The Outlands and Sigil} (see the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG} for more information about this plane of existence). There they must wait for the train to arrive.
data/11/entries/7/entries/4/entries/0.zh_tw: 格利奇的身體內嵌有一個 {@item amulet of the planes||位面護符}，如果格利奇的生命值降至 0 點，這個護符（連同四元冢的其餘部分）將化為塵土。格利奇使用這個內建的護符施展 {@spell plane shift||位面轉移}法術，將自己和角色們傳送到 {@book 外域|DMG|2|The Outlands and Sigil}的一個田野中（有關這個位面的更多資訊，請參見 {@book 城主指南|DMG}）。在那裡，他們必須等待火車的到來。
data/11/entries/7/entries/4/entries/0.reason: Remove duplicate glosses and distinguish Outlands from the Outer Planes.

data/11/entries/7/entries/6/entries/3/en.english: Hostile modrons patrol the rooftops of the cars, attacking anyone they see who isn't supposed to be there. Whenever one or more characters reach the midpoint of a rooftop on any car other than the Jail Car, roll a {@dice d6} and use the Guard Patrols table to determine if an encounter occurs. Assume the patrol begins the encounter on the rooftop of an adjoining car. All the modrons have {@sense truesight}, and characters on the rooftop have nowhere to hide.
data/11/entries/7/entries/6/entries/3/en.zh_tw: 敵對的魔冢在車廂的屋頂上巡邏，攻擊任何他們看到的不應該在那裡的人。每當一個或多個角色到達任何車廂（除了監獄車廂）屋頂的中點時，擲一個{@dice d6}骰子，並使用守衛巡邏表來確定是否發生遭遇。假設巡邏隊在相鄰車廂的屋頂上開始遭遇。所有的魔冢都有{@sense truesight||真實視覺}，並且屋頂上的角色無處可藏。

data/11/entries/7/entries/7/entries/3/ro.english: Acheron. The train flies over a vast battlefield where legions of devils clash with hordes of demons. Whenever one creature aboard the train deals damage to another creature aboard the train, both take 4 ({@dice 1d8}) psychic damage.
data/11/entries/7/entries/7/entries/3/ro.zh_tw: 修羅場。列車飛越一個廣闊的戰場，那裡有魔鬼軍團與惡魔大軍激戰。每當列車上的一個生物對列車上的另一個生物造成傷害時，兩者都會受到4點（{@dice 1d8}）心靈傷害。
data/11/entries/7/entries/7/entries/3/ro.reason: Keep the opposing devil and demon armies distinct.

data/11/entries/8/entries/3/entries/5/en.english: A character who studies the equations for at least 10 minutes can make a {@dc 25} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check at the end of that time. If the check fails, the character takes 3 ({@dice 1d6}) psychic damage and suffers a mild headache for the next hour. If the check succeeds, the character discovers a profound equation nestled among the others. Like a key, this equation unlocks something in the character's brain, with the effect determined by rolling on the Mysterious Equation table. A character who experiences this revelation gains no further benefit from studying the chalkboard equations. If any of the equations are erased, the modrons in the car turn hostile and attack, and no one can benefit from studying the equations.
data/11/entries/8/entries/3/entries/5/en.zh_tw: 一個角色如果研究了這些方程式至少10分鐘，可以在結束時進行一個 {@dc 25} 智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定。如果檢定失敗，角色受到3點（{@dice 1d6}）心靈傷害，並在接下來的一個小時裡感到輕微頭痛。如果檢定成功，角色會發現一個深奧的方程式夾雜在其他式子中。這個方程式就像一把鑰匙，解鎖了角色大腦中的某個東西，其效果由在神秘方程式表上擲骰決定。經歷此啟示的角色不會從繼續研究黑板方程式中獲得更多好處。如果任何方程式被擦除，車廂中的魔冢會變得敵對並發動攻擊，沒有人能從研究這些方程式中獲得好處。
data/11/entries/8/entries/3/entries/5/en.reason: The occupants are modrons, not golems.

data/11/entries/8/entries/6/entries/3/en.english: Cosmo can give a brief lecture on any {@book plane of existence|DMG|2} described in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}. If a character asks about a plane on the train's route, Cosmo also alludes to noteworthy planar effects. For example, if asked about the Nine Hells, the spectral duodrone might say, "Rest assured, the Concordant Express is reinforced to withstand extreme heat and extreme cold." Cosmo lectures about one plane per donation and vanishes after each lecture.
data/11/entries/8/entries/6/entries/3/en.zh_tw: 考斯莫可以簡要講解任何在{@book 城主指南|DMG}中描述的{@book 位面|DMG|2}。如果有角色詢問關於列車路線上的位面，考斯莫還會提及值得注意的位面效應。例如，如果被問及九層地獄，這個幽影般的二元冢可能會說："請放心，和諧號列車已加固以承受極端高溫和極端低溫。" 考斯莫每次講解一個位面後便會消失，且每次講解需要一次捐贈。
data/11/entries/8/entries/6/entries/3/en.reason: Use plane terminology and the canonical duodrone creature name.

data/11/entries/8/entries/7/entries/2/en.english: The detective is a lawful neutral {@creature mind flayer} named {@creature Ignatius Inkblot|KftGV}. Seeing the characters, Ignatius lights a pipe with a match it holds with one of its face tentacles. The pipe exudes a green vapor that smells of absinthe. Since the characters weren't on the car when the murder occurred, Ignatius doesn't regard them as suspects and is friendly toward them. Ignatius can speak Common but loathes doing so; the mind flayer prefers to converse telepathically. Its tone is strident, and it uses stereotypical detective phrases such as "The game is afoot!" and "The devil is in the details!"
data/11/entries/8/entries/7/entries/2/en.zh_tw: 這位偵探是一個守序中立的{@creature mind flayer||奪心魔}，名叫{@creature Ignatius Inkblot|KftGV|伊格納提斯·墨跡}。看到角色們，伊格納提斯用它的一根面部觸手拿著火柴點燃了菸鬥。菸鬥散發出一股帶有苦艾酒氣味的綠色煙霧。由於角色們在謀殺發生時並不在車廂內，伊格納提斯不將他們視為嫌疑人，對他們態度友好。伊格納提斯會說通用語，但不喜歡這樣做；奪心魔更喜歡用心靈感應進行交流。它的語調尖銳，並且使用諸如"好戲開始了！"和"魔鬼藏在細節中！"等典型的偵探用語。
data/11/entries/8/entries/7/entries/2/en.reason: Correct duplicated prose and detective idiom without changing telepathy or attitude.

data/11/entries/8/entries/8/entries/4/en.english: The slaad's master watches the battle unfold through an invisible scrying sensor like the one created by a {@spell scrying} spell. If the characters defeat the slaad, a magically altered voice issues from the invisible sensor and says in Common, "So much for that. Next time you won't be so lucky!" If the characters are working for the Golden Vault, the voice adds, "The Golden Vault won't be able to protect you from our wrath." The scrying sensor then disappears.
data/11/entries/8/entries/8/entries/4/en.zh_tw: 史拉蟾的主人透過一個如同由{@spell scrying||探知術}法術所創造的隱形探知感測器觀察戰鬥的發展。如果角色們擊敗了史拉蟾，一個經過魔法改變的聲音從隱形偵測器中發出，並用通用語說："就這樣了。下一次你們不會這麼幸運！"如果角色們為黃金寶庫工作，聲音補充說："黃金寶庫無法保護你們免受我們的憤怒。"然後偵測器消失了。
data/11/entries/8/entries/8/entries/4/en.reason: Source says like a scrying sensor, not that the spell necessarily created it.

data/12/entries/4/entries/1/entries/0.english: "Greetings, operatives. A magical diamond called a shard solitaire is known to contain an unstable extradimensional rift. Its owner, {@creature Zorhanna Adulare|KftGV}, is a retired adventurer. Her husband, Eliphas, used to work for the Golden Vault. He suspects that an evil force has somehow entered the stone and is using it to control Zorhanna. He has asked the Golden Vault to steal the stone from Paliset Hall, where he and Zorhanna host their annual gala celebrating the winter solstice.
data/12/entries/4/entries/1/entries/0.zh_tw: "問候，特工們。一顆被稱為碎晶掛飾的魔法鑽石，被認為包含一個不穩定的超維度裂縫。它的主人，{@creature Zorhanna Adulare|KftGV|佐哈娜·阿杜拉雷}，是一位退休的冒險家。她的丈夫伊萊法斯，曾為金庫工作。他懷疑某種邪惡力量以某種方式進入了這塊石頭，並正在利用它來控制佐哈娜。他已請求金庫從帕利塞特莊園偷走這塊石頭，他和佐哈娜在那裡舉辦一年一度的晚會，慶祝冬至。"
data/12/entries/4/entries/1/entries/0.reason: Shard solitaire is the named diamond magic item.

data/12/entries/9/entries/5/entries/21/e.english: As an action, a character can make a {@dc 17} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check while trying to convince Zorhanna that the party is not her enemy. If the check is successful, Zorhanna does nothing on her next turn except mutter to herself as she ponders what the character said. If the check fails, Zorhanna continues her attack. Once three such checks succeed, Zorhanna concludes that the characters are not her enemies and calls for an end to hostilities. She then screams into the void, "You almost had me! Nice try, whatever you are!"
data/12/entries/9/entries/5/entries/21/e.zh_tw: 作為一個動作，角色可以進行一次 {@dc 17} 魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，試圖說服佐蘭娜相信團隊不是她的敵人。如果檢定成功，佐蘭娜在她的下一回合中除了自言自語地思考角色所說的話外，不會做任何其他事情。如果檢定失敗，佐蘭娜會繼續攻擊。一旦三次這樣的檢定成功，佐蘭娜會得出結論認為角色們不是她的敵人，並呼籲停止敵對行動。然後她對著虛空尖叫，"你差點就控制住我了！休想得逞，不管你是什麼東西！"
data/12/entries/9/entries/5/entries/21/e.reason: Zorhanna addresses the controlling entity, not the party; retain three successful checks and next-turn effect.

data/12/entries/9/entries/5/entries/11/e.english: One of the paintings depicts a reindeer-shaped creature made of dark woven branches and emerald-green leaves. If a creature moves within 5 feet of the painting, the image animates, and the wooden reindeer-like creature cheerfully introduces itself as Oak, personal assistant to Zorhanna and Eliphas.
data/12/entries/9/entries/5/entries/11/e.zh_tw: 其中一幅畫描繪了一隻馴鹿形狀的生物，由深色交織枝條與翠綠葉片構成。當生物接近畫作 5 尺內時，畫像便活動起來；那隻木製馴鹿般的生物會愉快地自我介紹，說自己名叫奧克（Oak，意為「橡樹」），是佐哈娜與伊萊法斯的私人助手。
data/12/entries/9/entries/5/entries/11/e.reason: Retain Oak in the clue because the three-ring combination spells OAK.

data/12/entries/9/entries/5/entries/13/e.english: The three concentric, gilded rings at the bottom of the pool are the locking mechanisms for a hidden safe. Each ring is flat and set in a shallow groove, such that it can be rotated. Once the water in the pool is drained, tiny Elvish runes representing the letters A through Z magically appear on the surface of each ring, with the letters spaced around the ring at equal intervals. Opening the safe requires that the three rings be turned in their grooves until their runes line up to form the word "OAK." Only Zorhanna and her simulacrum know the correct combination of letters (although "OAK" is a direct reference to the magic painting in {@area area P10|492|x}).
data/12/entries/9/entries/5/entries/13/e.zh_tw: 水池底部的三個同心鍍金圓環是一個隱藏保險箱的鎖定機制。每個圓環都是平的，並且設定在一個淺槽中，可以旋轉。一旦水池中的水被排幹，代表字母A到Z的微小精靈符文就會神奇地出現在每個圓環的表面上，字母在圓環上以相等的間隔排列。開啟保險箱需要將三個圓環在它們的槽中旋轉，直到它們的符文排成單詞「OAK」（奧克的名字，意為「橡樹」）。只有佐哈娜和她的擬像知道正確的字母組合（儘管"OAK"是對{@area 區域P10|492|x}中魔法畫的直接引用）。
data/12/entries/9/entries/5/entries/13/e.reason: Keep literal A–Z and OAK required by the letter puzzle; add Chinese reading aid.

data/13/entries/5/entries/3/entries/1.english: Remi has gotten the necessary information from Nebukath, but stealing the book is beyond her ability, so she recruits the characters to carry out this task for the order. Remi offers no reward, but if the characters bring the book or proof of its destruction to the order, each character receives a {@book blessing|DMG|7|Blessings} of their choice, either from the gods they worship or from a god worshiped by Remi's holy order: a {@reward blessing of health}, a {@reward blessing of protection}, or a {@reward blessing of understanding}, all of which are described in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}.
data/13/entries/5/entries/3/entries/1.zh_tw: 雷米已從內布卡斯取得必要資訊，但偷取這本書超出了她的能力，因此她招募角色替教團執行任務。雷米本人不提供報酬；不過，如果角色將書或其已被摧毀的證據交給教團，每位角色都能從下列{@book 祝福|DMG|7|Blessings}中選擇一項：{@reward blessing of health}、{@reward blessing of protection}或{@reward blessing of understanding}。祝福可由角色信奉的神祇賜予，也可來自雷米教團所崇拜的神祇；這些祝福皆詳述於{@book 城主指南|DMG}。
data/13/entries/5/entries/3/entries/1.reason: Order is a religious organization; preserve reward eligibility, choice, and deity alternatives.

data/13/entries/7/entries/4/entries/1/it.english: The hold is defended by {@creature erinyes} devils (whose {@sense truesight} allows them to see through most forms of magical concealment), duergar, and {@creature Salamander||salamanders}, as well as a {@creature young red dragon} named Kalimrax and a {@creature beholder} known as the Eye of the Efreet.
data/13/entries/7/entries/4/entries/1/it.zh_tw: 堡的防禦由{@creature erinyes||罪魔}魔鬼（他們的{@sense truesight||真實視覺}使他們能夠看穿大多數魔法隱蔽形式）、灰矮人、{@creature Salamander||火蜥蜴}組成，還有一條名叫卡利姆拉克斯的{@creature young red dragon||青年紅龍}和被稱為火巨靈之眼的{@creature beholder||眼魔}。

data/13/entries/8/entries/2/entries/3/en.english: Creatures that spend 1 hour or more anywhere in the hold, or sail on the river of lava, are subject to the effects of {@book extreme heat|DMG|5|Extreme Heat} as described in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}.
data/13/entries/8/entries/2/entries/3/en.zh_tw: 在硫磺堡內任何位置停留1小時或更長時間或航行在熔岩河上的生物，將受到{@book 極度高溫|DMG|5|Extreme Heat}的影響，如{@book 城主指南|DMG}中所述。
data/13/entries/8/entries/2/entries/3/en.reason: Restore the location restriction on extreme heat exposure.

data/13/entries/8/entries/5/entries/5/en.english: The duergar pay little mind to anyone they believe to be on legitimate business in the hold. However, they don't allow anyone to communicate with the prisoners unless ordered to by one of the efreet. The duergar issue a stern warning the first time anyone makes unapproved contact with a prisoner, and they turn hostile after a second instance, attempting to subdue and capture the offender.
data/13/entries/8/entries/5/entries/5/en.zh_tw: 灰矮人對那些他們認為是在堡內有合法事務的人不太關注。然而，除非是火巨靈的命令，他們不允許任何人與囚犯交流。如果有人第一次未經批准與囚犯接觸，灰矮人會發出嚴厲的警告，並且如果再有第二次，他們會轉為敵對，試圖制服並捕獲違規者。
data/13/entries/8/entries/5/entries/5/en.reason: Efreet is the plural of efreeti, not a separate named person.

data/13/entries/8/entries/5/entries/25/e.english: Among the arcanaloth's library is a volume entitled The Blood War, which describes the unending conflict between devils of the Nine Hells and the demons of the Abyss. The tome is worth 500 gp to a collector. Scribbled in the margin of one page is the sequence for a teleportation circle that leads to Avernus, the first layer of the Nine Hells.
data/13/entries/8/entries/5/entries/25/e.zh_tw: 在奧法羅斯魔的圖書館中，有一本名為《血戰》的卷冊，它描述了九層地獄的魔鬼和無底深淵的惡魔之間無休止的衝突。這本書對收藏家來說價值500金幣。在其中一頁的邊緣潦草地寫著一個傳送圈的序列，它通向阿弗納斯，即九層地獄的第一層。
data/13/entries/8/entries/5/entries/25/e.reason: Blood War pits devils against demons.

data/13/entries/8/entries/5/entries/28/e.english: The statues are two {@creature Stone Golem||stone golems} that are normally quiescent and don't react to the characters' presence. However, the golems are magically attuned to the door to area B29 and become hostile if a creature attempts to open the door by any means other than using Vrakir's key. A character who succeeds on their ability check to pick the lock by 10 or more avoids triggering the golems. Entering area B29 by using magic (such as the {@spell passwall} spell) to bypass the door entirely doesn't trigger the golems.
data/13/entries/8/entries/5/entries/28/e.zh_tw: 這些雕像是兩個{@creature Stone Golem||石魔像}，它們通常處於靜止狀態，不會對角色們的存在做出反應。然而，這些魔像被魔法調諧到通往B29區域的門，如果有任何生物試圖以非弗拉基爾的鑰匙的方式開門，它們就會變得敵對。如果角色嘗試撬鎖的屬性檢定結果比 DC 高出10或更多，就可以避免觸發魔像。透過使用魔法（例如{@spell passwall||穿牆術}法術）完全繞過門進入B29區域，不會觸發魔像。
data/13/entries/8/entries/5/entries/28/e.reason: Succeed by 10 means margin over DC, not a result over 10.

data/13/entries/8/entries/5/entries/30/e.english: The key to opening the door is the gemstone set in the wall carving. The gem is trapped with a 6th-level {@spell glyph of warding} spell. The glyph casts {@spell disintegrate} on any creature that touches the gem without speaking Vrakir's motto: atka ignari. While touching the gem, a creature can take an action to open the door to area B30 as if the creature had cast the {@spell demiplane} spell; this causes the face in the wall to stretch its mouth wide as a shimmering gray portal appears within. Removing the gem from the wall causes the doorway to disappear, trapping anything in area B30 in the demiplane until the gem is replaced or someone else accesses the room with a {@spell demiplane} spell.

data/10/entries/3/entries/1.english: Known for its exquisite glasswork, Ghalasine was a prosperous city ruled by {@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV} Astolko. Governing from Castle Cinis, Jhaeros was advised by two councilors, Regine LaVerne and {@creature Charmayne Daymore|KftGV}, and a guard captain named {@creature Naevys Tharesso|KftGV}. Jhaeros's rule was compassionate, just, and kind. Over the last year, however, Naevys watched with growing concern as Jhaeros became more withdrawn and secretive, closing Ghalasine to trade and failing to honor his alliances.
data/10/entries/3/entries/1.zh_tw: 加拉辛以其精美的玻璃工藝聞名，曾是一個由{@creature King Jhaeros|KftGV|國王賈埃羅斯} 阿斯托爾科統治的繁榮城市。賈埃羅斯從灰燼城堡治理國家，得到兩位顧問蕾吉娜·拉維恩和{@creature Charmayne Daymore|KftGV|夏梅恩·德墨爾}以及名叫{@creature Naevys Tharesso|KftGV|納維斯·薩雷斯}的衛隊隊長的建議。賈埃羅斯的統治是富有同情心、公正和仁慈的。然而，在過去的一年裡，納維斯對賈埃羅斯變得越來越孤僻和神秘感到日益擔憂，他關閉了加拉辛的貿易，未能履行他的聯盟承諾。

data/11/entries/9/entries/0.english: After imparting the true names, the freed Stranger tips their hat and leaps from the train. Once out of range of the train's teleportation ward, {@creature the Stranger|KftGV} casts {@spell plane shift} and disappears. The characters can leave the Concordant Express in a similar fashion, or they can remain on the train until it arrives in Mechanus and secure safe passage home from there. Whether or not they helped solve the murder in the Passenger Car ({@area area E7|43e|x}), characters who disembark in Mechanus see {@creature Ignatius Inkblot|KftGV}, the mind flayer detective, escorting the cambion Abernathy Vernus off the train and into the waiting arms of a group of modrons.
data/11/entries/9/entries/0.zh_tw: 在透露了真實姓名之後，被釋放的陌生人輕扶帽沿致意，從列車上跳下。一旦離開了列車的傳送防護範圍，{@creature the Stranger|KftGV|陌生人}施放了{@spell plane shift||位面轉移}法術然後消失了。角色們可以以類似的方式離開協和快車，或者他們可以留在列車上，直到它抵達機械境，並從那裡獲得安全回家的通道。無論他們是否幫助解決了乘客車廂中的謀殺案（{@area 區域E7|43e|x}），在機械境下車的角色們會看到奪心魔偵探{@creature Ignatius Inkblot|KftGV|伊格納提斯·墨跡}，護送著坎比翁Abernathy Vernus下列車，進入一群魔冢的等待之中。
